body: did you know: "willow" almost didn't exist. aaron dessner had a spare instrumental sketch he called "westerly," after taylor's rhode island town, and sent it over not expecting anything back. she wrote the whole song to it within the hour.
why: Did-you-know track fact on evermore, the second-thinnest era corner -- evermore's last coverage was 'no body no crime' (posted 08-05) and 'tolerate it' (posted 07-29), so it's due, and there's no exact Aug-16 on-this-day Vault match. Shipped X-only on purpose: the only honest IG media is evermore.png, which the repeatsRecentEraArt guard would block (evermore.png posted 08-05, still inside the last-10 IG window on 08-16), so X is the guard-safe way to run this rather than force a silently-blocked IG post -- same reasoning as the queued 08-12 Showgirl and 08-13 Red X-only items. Every claim traces to the Vault evermore item 'willow, and the spell it's supposed to sound like' (sourced Wikipedia + Rolling Stone): Aaron Dessner's spare 'Westerly' instrumental sketch (named for her Rhode Island home) sent without expecting a reply, Taylor writing the full song to it within the hour, her 'sounds like casting a spell to make someone fall in love with you' description, the self-directed video (her third) picking up where 'cardigan' left off and following a golden thread through the woods, and the official 'dancing witch / lonely witch / moonlit witch' remixes. Short attributed quote fragment only, no verbatim lyrics. Song-craft lore, outside every #36/Clownbot blocklist topic.
